apps.name: Guardrail EHS
apps.description: Free, open-source environmental, health & safety software: actions, observations, safety training and more, with your records kept on your own PC.

apps.name: Draftly
apps.description: Modern word processor with tabs, headings, links, line numbers, pictures, tables and Light or Dark mode. Opens RTF, TXT, Markdown and Word files.

apps.name: ShoreDrop
apps.description: FTP, FTPS and SFTP client for moving files to and from your servers, with a dual-pane browser, transfer queue, site manager and light and dark themes.

apps.name: Discshelf
apps.description: Music player for the music on your computer, inspired by Songbird: albums, artists, playlists, Up Next, ratings, lyrics, a visualizer, gapless playback and crossfade, an equalizer, radio and Last.fm scrobbling. Modern, Classic and iTunes styles in light and dark. Plays MP3, AAC, FLAC, Ogg, Opus and WAV.

apps.name: Sumthing
apps.description: Calculator with a paper tape, sums you can type in words, a unit and currency converter, and tip, discount, percent and date tools. Light, Dark or Classic (Windows 7) look.

apps.name: Taskflare
apps.description: Free to-do list in the style of Microsoft To Do and Todoist: My Day, Important, Planned, lists, quick add that understands dates, reminders and Light or Dark mode. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, Muse and Siri can add tasks for you.

apps.name: Boardwalk
apps.description: Kanban boards for your projects: as many boards as you like, statuses like New, In progress, On hold and Complete, and cards with labels, priority, due dates, checklists and links that you drag between them. Light or Dark mode. Sync between devices is coming soon.

apps.name: CoinPilot
apps.description: Budgeting app for tracking spending and planning where your money goes, with sync to your phone on the way. Early preview: the Dashboard shows the planned layout and the other sections are coming soon.

apps.name: Shutterbox
apps.description: Photo organizer for the pictures already on your PC: a timeline by day, month or year, albums, favorites, tags, search, a viewer with slideshows, and import from cameras and phones. Your files stay where they are.

apps.name: Sparecopy
apps.description: Backup for your family's PCs to a NAS, server or USB drive, with one dashboard for every device at every house. Early preview: the Overview shows the planned layout and the other sections are coming soon.

apps.name: Castaway
apps.description: Media player for your own movies and shows in the style of Plex: libraries for Movies, TV Shows, Kids & Family, Documentaries, Stand-Up and Anime, in light or dark. Early preview: the Castaway server that holds and streams your media, and playback, are coming soon.

apps.name: Larksong
apps.description: Alarm clock with your own sounds and gently rising volume, wake to the radio, sleep sounds, bedtime reminders, a stopwatch and timer, world clocks and weather. Styles include Larksong, Dawn, Dusk, Retro, a clock radio with a world radio tuner, and Terminal.

apps.name: Larksong Classic
apps.description: Larksong for older PCs: one small program that runs on every version from Windows 95 to Windows 11, with alarms, a stopwatch and timer, world clocks and a bedtime reminder. Backups move your alarms between it and Larksong.

apps.name: Fleetwatch
apps.description: Look after the computers you're responsible for from one place: each PC's status and pending Windows updates, its error logs, and installing apps, updates and restarts remotely. Installs a background agent that reports to your own Fleetwatch server.
